title: alliaria arborescens
intro: Alliaria arborescens, commonly known as Tree Garlic or Wild Garlic, is a perennial plant belonging to the Brassicaceae family. It is used for its medicinal properties, which include reducing inflammation and relieving respiratory issues such as coughs and colds due to its health benefits. The therapeutic actions of Tree Garlic are attributed to its antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial properties, which help in soothing various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Tree Garlic include isothiocyanates, flavonoids, and phenolic acids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
